sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已上线，欢迎在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: Hi, it's Casey here.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是凯西。

sentences.en: As you know, Casefile will be back in 2026 for our 10th year with all new episodes.
sentences.zh: 如你们所知，Casefile 将在2026年回归，迎来我们的第十个年头，并带来全新的剧集。

sentences.en: Earlier this year, you might have noticed that we released the first episodes of some of the Casefile Presents shows we've produced in the Casefile feed.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，你们可能注意到我们在 Casefile 的节目源中发布了我们制作的一些“Casefile Presents”系列节目的首集。

sentences.en: The decision to do this came after I learnt something surprising while talking to people at our live events.
sentences.zh: 做出这个决定，是因为我在参加线下活动时了解到了一些令人惊讶的情况。

sentences.en: Many Casefile listeners had no idea that we produce other shows outside of Casefile, and some had never even heard of Casefile Presents.
sentences.zh: 许多 Casefile 的听众根本不知道我们除了 Casefile 之外还制作其他节目，有些人甚至从未听说过“Casefile Presents”。

sentences.en: It dawned on me that if someone is a big enough supporter of our show to come to a live event, but hasn't heard of our production company,
sentences.zh: 我意识到，如果一个人是我们的忠实听众，甚至愿意来参加线下活动，却还没听说过我们的制作公司，

sentences.en: then clearly we need to do a better job of highlighting the other stories we've put so much care and work into.
sentences.zh: 那么显然，我们需要在推广我们投入了大量心血和工作的其他故事方面做得更好。

sentences.en: For those who don't know, Casefile Presents is our broader production platform.
sentences.zh: 对于那些不知道的人，我介绍一下，“Casefile Presents”是我们更广泛的制作平台。

sentences.en: While Casefile is our flagship show, we've also created a number of other podcasts under the Casefile Presents banner.
sentences.zh: 虽然 Casefile 是我们的旗舰节目，但我们也以“Casefile Presents”的名义制作了许多其他播客。

sentences.en: Our level of involvement differs from project to project, but we've played a direct role in all of them, and I even narrate a few myself.
sentences.zh: 我们对每个项目的参与程度各不相同，但我们直接参与了所有项目的制作，其中一些甚至由我亲自担任旁白。

sentences.en: Today, we're sharing another one of those shows, The Detective's Dilemma, which is narrated by me.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要分享的是另一个系列节目——《侦探的困境》，由我担任旁白。

sentences.en: The Detective's Dilemma was originally released as a Spotify exclusive, meaning you could only listen to it on that platform.
sentences.zh: 《侦探的困境》最初是作为 Spotify 的独家节目发布的，这意味着你只能在那个平台上收听。

sentences.en: But now, for the first time, the entire series is available everywhere, for free, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 但现在，整个系列首次在所有平台免费上线，你可以在任何获取播客的地方收听。

sentences.en: When 22-year-old Shano Callaghan went missing, Detective Steve Fulcher arrested a suspect who offered to lead him to her body.
sentences.zh: 当22岁的莎诺·卡拉汉失踪时，史蒂夫·富尔彻警探逮捕了一名嫌疑人，对方提出带他去寻找受害者的遗体。

sentences.en: When the suspect then asked, do you want another one, it set in motion one of the most significant and controversial investigations in recent UK history.
sentences.zh: 当嫌疑人随后问出“你还想要另一个吗”时，这引发了英国近代史上最重大且最具争议的调查之一。

sentences.en: The Detective's Dilemma explores the complex questions it raised about the justice system, police procedure, and the cost of doing what you believe is right.
sentences.zh: 《侦探的困境》探讨了该案在司法系统、警察程序以及为坚信正确之事所付出的代价等方面提出的复杂问题。

sentences.en: It's a story that leaves you asking, what would you have done in the same situation?
sentences.zh: 这是一个让你不禁自问的故事：如果你身处同样的情况，你会怎么做？

sentences.en: We're releasing the first episode here on the Casefile feed.
sentences.zh: 我们正在 Casefile 的节目源中发布第一集。

sentences.en: You can find the full series by searching for The Detective's Dilemma wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 你可以在各大播客平台搜索《侦探的困境》来收听完整系列。

sentences.en: Now, here's episode one.
sentences.zh: 现在，请收听第一集。

sentences.en: We covered the disappearance of Shano Callaghan and the subsequent investigation back on episode 35 of Casefile.
sentences.zh: 我们曾在 Casefile 第35集中报道过莎诺·卡拉汉的失踪及其随后的调查。

sentences.en: It's one of those episodes that has just stayed with me.
sentences.zh: 那是让我至今难以忘怀的剧集之一。

sentences.en: It's an extraordinary story, which shows better than almost any other, the gravity of the decisions a senior detective must make in the heat of a fast-moving investigation,
sentences.zh: 这是一个非凡的故事，它比几乎任何其他案件都更能体现一名高级侦探在快节奏调查的紧要关头所做决策的分量，

sentences.en: and the very fine line a modern investigator must walk to balance operational effectiveness with today's increasingly stringent procedures.
sentences.zh: 以及现代调查人员在平衡行动效率与当今日益严格的程序时所必须跨越的微妙界限。

sentences.en: With exclusive access to the key characters in this story, including family members and lead investigator Steve Fulcher,
sentences.zh: 通过对本案关键人物（包括家属和首席调查员史蒂夫·富尔彻）的独家采访，

sentences.en: we will go behind the scenes to unravel how the investigation unfolded and the minefield of legal and ethical dilemmas that distinguish this case so starkly from the norm.
sentences.zh: 我们将深入幕后，揭开调查是如何展开的，以及那些让本案与众不同的法律和道德困境雷区。

sentences.en: And we will leave you to ponder the fundamental question at the heart of this perplexing tale.
sentences.zh: 我们将留给你们去思考这个扑朔迷离的故事核心所蕴含的根本问题。

sentences.en: If it had been your loved one that Steve Fulcher was looking for, what would you have wanted him to do?
sentences.zh: 如果史蒂夫·富尔彻寻找的是你的亲人，你会希望他怎么做？

sentences.en: And at the same time, try and step into his shoes and ask yourself,
sentences.zh: 同时，试着设身处地地想一想，问问自己，

sentences.en: what would you have done?
sentences.zh: 你会怎么做？

sentences.en: When Detective Superintendent Steve Fulcher of Wiltshire Police first heard of the disappearance of Sharno Callaghan,
sentences.zh: 当威尔特郡警局的侦探警司史蒂夫·富尔彻第一次听说莎诺·卡拉汉失踪时，

sentences.en: he had no idea this case would change his life forever.
sentences.zh: 他并不知道这个案件会彻底改变他的人生。

sentences.en: Sharno was a 22-year-old girl, very attractive.
sentences.zh: 莎诺是一个22岁的女孩，非常漂亮。

sentences.en: She was an office worker.
sentences.zh: 她是一名办公室职员。

sentences.en: She lived locally in Swindon.
sentences.zh: 她住在斯温登当地。

sentences.en: Her family was local.
sentences.zh: 她的家人也住在当地。

sentences.en: She was in a loving relationship with her boyfriend, Kevin.
sentences.zh: 她与男友凯文感情稳定。

sentences.en: She had a close-knit family, mother Elaine, a brother and two sisters, and was just enjoying a night out in Swindon on that particular Friday night into Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 她有一个关系紧密的家庭，母亲伊莱恩，还有一个哥哥和两个姐姐。那个周五晚上到周六凌晨，她正享受着在斯温登的夜生活。

sentences.en: Sharno Callaghan's mother, Elaine Pickford, says her daughter could light up a room.
sentences.zh: 莎诺·卡拉汉的母亲伊莱恩·皮克福德说，她的女儿能点亮整个房间。

sentences.en: Sharno was a very vibrant person, always happy, smiling, fun-loving, sociable.
sentences.zh: 莎诺是一个非常有活力的人，总是很快乐、爱笑、热爱生活、善于交际。

sentences.en: You know, one of those people that would walk in a room and did light the room up.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她是那种走进房间就能让整个房间亮起来的人。

sentences.en: I know people say that a lot about people, but in Sharn's case, it's definitely true.
sentences.zh: 我知道人们经常这样评价别人，但在莎诺身上，这绝对是真的。

sentences.en: Atmospheres would change if Sharn was around.
sentences.zh: 只要莎诺在场，气氛就会变得不同。

sentences.en: You know, everybody liked Sharn, loads of friends, sociable, outgoing, bubbly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每个人都喜欢莎诺，她有很多朋友，善于交际、外向、活泼。

sentences.en: Yeah, and never really gave me any hassles growing up particularly.
sentences.zh: 是的，她从小到大没给我惹过什么麻烦。

sentences.en: You know, all the usual stuff, but nothing out of the ordinary, yeah.
sentences.zh: 你知道，都是些寻常琐事，没什么特别的，真的。

sentences.en: Swindon is a large town in the county of Wiltshire, southwest England, about 126 kilometres west of London.
sentences.zh: 斯温登是英格兰西南部威尔特郡的一个大镇，位于伦敦以西约126公里处。

sentences.en: With a population of about 185,000 people, it has one of the lower crime rates in the country.
sentences.zh: 这里人口约18.5万，犯罪率在全国处于较低水平。

sentences.en: On the evening of Friday the 18th of March 2011, Sharno Callaghan had a night out with some friends in the Old Town area of Swindon.
sentences.zh: 2011年3月18日星期五晚上，莎诺·卡拉汉和朋友们在斯温登的老城区度过了一个夜晚。

sentences.en: They went out for dinner before visiting two bars, The Spot and Baker Street, after which they went to a nightclub called Suju.
sentences.zh: 她们先去吃了晚餐，然后去了两家酒吧——“The Spot”和“Baker Street”，之后又去了一家叫“Suju”的夜店。

sentences.en: Sharn left the Suju nightclub alone in the early hours of the morning of Saturday the 19th of March.
sentences.zh: 3月19日星期六凌晨，莎诺独自离开了 Suju 夜店。

sentences.en: The flat she shared with her boyfriend Kevin was only 800 metres away from the club.
sentences.zh: 她与男友凯文合租的公寓距离夜店只有800米。

sentences.en: But she didn't make it home that night.
sentences.zh: 但那天晚上她没能回到家。

sentences.en: Concerned by the fact Sharn hadn't returned back to their flat, Kevin sent her a text message at 3.24am to check if she was okay.
sentences.zh: 由于担心莎诺没有回到公寓，凯文在凌晨3点24分给她发了一条短信，询问她是否平安。

sentences.en: The first contact was from Kevin Reap, Sharno Callaghan's boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 第一个联系我们的是凯文·里普，也就是莎诺·卡拉汉的男友。

sentences.en: They'd been together about 18 months.
sentences.zh: 他们在一起大约18个月了。

sentences.en: He contacted the police on the morning of Saturday the 19th of March 2011.
sentences.zh: 他在2011年3月19日星期六早上联系了警方。

sentences.en: He was concerned about Sharno because she hadn't been in contact with him.
sentences.zh: 他很担心莎诺，因为她一直没和他联系。

sentences.en: All he knew was that at 3.24am, he'd sent a text to her saying, worried, with a kiss, and it hadn't been responded to.
sentences.zh: 他只知道在凌晨3点24分，他给她发了一条短信，写着“很担心”，后面加了一个吻的表情，但没有收到回复。

sentences.en: He'd been desperately trying to phone her phone, phone friends, family, to find out where she was.
sentences.zh: 他一直在拼命拨打她的电话，联系她的朋友和家人，想知道她在哪里。

sentences.en: Now, Sharno had gone out for a night out in Swindon Old Town with a couple of female friends,
sentences.zh: 莎诺当时和几个女性朋友在斯温登老城区过夜，

sentences.en: and they'd gone to various pubs and clubs, and that was as much as Kevin could tell us at that particular point in time.
sentences.zh: 她们去了几家酒吧和夜店，这就是凯文当时能告诉我们的全部信息。

sentences.en: Sharn's mother, Elaine, wasn't overly worried at firSt.
sentences.zh: 莎诺的母亲伊莱恩起初并没有太担心。

sentences.en: We just thought maybe she'd gone off, you know, to a mate's house afterwards, decided to stay over at a friend's and that she would be in touch.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想，也许她之后去了朋友家，决定在朋友那儿过夜，她会联系我们的。

sentences.en: It's easy to understand.
sentences.zh: 这很容易理解。

sentences.en: Sharn was 22.
sentences.zh: 莎诺22岁了。

sentences.en: The last thing her mother, Elaine, wanted to do was panic.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲伊莱恩最不想做的就是惊慌失措。

sentences.en: Even by late morning, I was just thinking, well, if she's been out to the early hours, she won't be up yet, you know,
sentences.zh: 即使到了上午晚些时候，我还在想，好吧，如果她玩到凌晨，现在肯定还没起床，你知道，

sentences.en: and if she's at a friend's, and then also you're thinking, well, hold on, there could be an explanation for this, even if she's woken up, her phone might be out of charge.
sentences.zh: 而且如果她在朋友家，你也会想，等等，这可能有合理的解释，即使她醒了，她的手机可能也没电了。

sentences.en: So you're kind of running through the logical explanations for it for quite some time, really.
sentences.zh: 所以你真的会花很长时间去推敲各种逻辑上的解释。

sentences.en: By the time I got home back in, I would say that was early afternoon.
sentences.zh: 当我回到家时，我想大概是下午早些时候。

sentences.en: There were police officers at the house when I arrived back home.
sentences.zh: 我到家时，家里已经有警察了。

sentences.en: So that then was quite an immediate concern that already the police were starting escalating it by the Saturday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 所以这立刻引起了我的担忧，因为到周六下午，警方就已经开始升级调查了。

sentences.en: After taking the initial report from Sharn's boyfriend, Kevin,
sentences.zh: 在收到莎诺男友凯文的初步报告后，

sentences.en: Swindon police immediately questioned the friends Sharn was out with.
sentences.zh: 斯温登警方立即询问了与莎诺一起外出的朋友。

sentences.en: They couldn't offer any useful information.
sentences.zh: 她们提供不了任何有用的信息。

sentences.en: They hadn't run into any issues throughout the night, and there were no incidents or suspicious people in the club.
sentences.zh: 她们整晚都没遇到任何问题，夜店里也没有发生任何事件或出现可疑人员。

sentences.en: CCTV footage from the Suju nightclub showed Sharn leaving the club alone at 2.52am.
sentences.zh: Suju 夜店的监控录像显示，莎诺在凌晨2点52分独自离开了夜店。

sentences.en: Detective Superintendent Steve Fulcher had done a colleague a favour and swapped his on-call weekend.
sentences.zh: 侦探警司史蒂夫·富尔彻当时帮了一位同事的忙，换了他的周末值班。

sentences.en: So I was on-call and at home, always remain in the county and in close proximity when on-call.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在值班，待在家里。值班时我总是留在郡内，并保持在近距离范围内。

sentences.en: Funnily enough, it wasn't my on-call weekend.
sentences.zh: 说来也巧，那本来不是我值班的周末。

sentences.en: I'd agreed to swap with a colleague because he'd been working so many hours on a different case.
sentences.zh: 我同意和一位同事换班，因为他在另一个案子上工作了太长时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, but for that, I'd have not picked up the Sharn O'Callaghan kidnap at all.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果不是这样，我根本不会接手莎诺·卡拉汉的绑架案。

sentences.en: At about 6 o'clock on Saturday, the 19th of March, I was called by officers from Swindon Police Station.
sentences.zh: 3月19日星期六下午6点左右，我接到了斯温登警局警官的电话。

sentences.en: They were increasingly concerned regarding the safety and welfare of Sharn O'Callaghan, who they'd been investigating as a missing person.
sentences.zh: 他们对莎诺·卡拉汉的安全和福祉越来越担忧，此前他们一直将她作为失踪人口进行调查。

sentences.en: They'd spent the day doing the obvious checks of hospitals, check of their home address and so on.
sentences.zh: 他们花了一整天时间对医院、她的住址等进行了常规检查。

sentences.en: They decided at that time to escalate the issue to me as the on-call senior investigating officer for the force.
sentences.zh: 他们当时决定将此事上报给我，作为该警队值班的高级调查官。

sentences.en: So, of course, I picked that issue up.
sentences.zh: 所以，我当然接手了这个案子。

sentences.en: I took a briefing over the telephone, obviously shared the concerns of the officers that had been investigating to that point
sentences.zh: 我通过电话听取了简报，显然我也认同之前负责调查的警官们的担忧，

sentences.en: and dropped everything and ran up to Swindon to see things firsthand,
sentences.zh: 于是我放下手头的一切，赶往斯温登去亲眼看看情况，

sentences.en: get a firsthand account and work out precisely what was known and what lines of inquiry we should be instigating with what level of resource and what urgency.
sentences.zh: 获取第一手资料，并弄清楚到底掌握了什么情况，以及我们应该以什么样的资源和紧迫性启动哪些调查方向。

sentences.en: The first call to the police came from Kevin Reap at about 9.40 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 警方接到的第一个电话是凯文·里普在早上9点40分左右打来的。

sentences.en: I got the call from my colleagues at about 6 o'clock in the evening.
sentences.zh: 我是在傍晚6点左右接到同事电话的。

sentences.en: So, during that intervening period of time, they'd have taken an account from the close associates of Sharn O'Callaghan,
sentences.zh: 所以，在这段时间里，他们已经记录了莎诺·卡拉汉亲密伙伴的陈述，

sentences.en: pieced together what could be established about her movements from the night before and some basic telephony.
sentences.zh: 拼凑出了她前一天晚上的行踪，并进行了一些基本的电话记录查询。

sentences.en: One of the first things investigators did was check Sharn's mobile phone records.
sentences.zh: 调查人员做的第一件事就是检查莎诺的手机记录。

sentences.en: The text message sent by Kevin at 3.24am pinged off a tower that put the location of Sharn's phone in the area of Savanak Forest at the time.
sentences.zh: 凯文在凌晨3点24分发送的短信连接到了一个基站，显示莎诺的手机当时位于萨瓦纳克森林地区。

sentences.en: The exact location of Sharn's phone could not be identified.
sentences.zh: 莎诺手机的确切位置无法确定。

sentences.en: It could only be narrowed down to a six and a half mile radius around the phone tower.
sentences.zh: 只能缩小到以手机基站为中心半径6.5英里的范围内。

sentences.en: For Steve Fulcher, that was the starting point of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 对史蒂夫·富尔彻来说，这就是调查的起点。

sentences.en: The location of the phone at the time of last contact had moved from Old Town in Swindon to somewhere in the Savanak Forest, a distance of some 20 miles.
sentences.zh: 手机在最后一次联系时的位置已经从斯温登老城区移动到了萨瓦纳克森林的某个地方，距离约20英里。

sentences.en: And that had happened between last known sightings of Sharn at about 10 to 3 in the morning till the last contact when her phone was in Savanak Forest at 3.24.
sentences.zh: 而这发生在莎诺最后一次被目击（凌晨2点50分左右）到最后一次联系（凌晨3点24分手机在萨瓦纳克森林）之间。

sentences.en: So within a half hour period, Sharn, or at least her phone, had moved from Old Town in Swindon to somewhere in the Savanak Forest with no obvious explanation.
sentences.zh: 所以，在半小时内，莎诺，或者至少是她的手机，从斯温登老城区移动到了萨瓦纳克森林的某个地方，没有任何合理的解释。

sentences.en: And that was a primary cause of concern.
sentences.zh: 这是主要的担忧原因。

sentences.en: The instinct is critical and makes the difference between the ability to save somebody's life or otherwise.
sentences.zh: 直觉至关重要，它决定了能否挽救某人的生命。

sentences.en: And I'd set three hypotheses, three possible answers to why her phone is suddenly in Savanak Forest at 3.24 and in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 我当时设定了三个假设，即为什么她的手机会在凌晨3点24分突然出现在萨瓦纳克森林的三个可能答案。

sentences.en: The first was, well, she could have gone off with somebody she met in Suju's nightclub.
sentences.zh: 第一个是，她可能和在 Suju 夜店认识的人一起离开了。

sentences.en: She could have had her phone stolen, and that could be in the middle of Savanak Forest, whereas she is somewhere else yet to be determined.
sentences.zh: 她的手机可能被偷了，手机在萨瓦纳克森林中心，而她本人在别处，还有待确定。

sentences.en: Or, the most worrying of all, of course, is that she has been taken there.
sentences.zh: 或者，最令人担忧的当然是，她被带到了那里。

sentences.en: And the question then, for Kevin Reap and for the family is, why would she go to the middle of Savanak Forest at 3.24 in the morning?
sentences.zh: 那么对于凯文·里普和她的家人来说，问题就是：为什么她会在凌晨3点24分去萨瓦纳克森林中心？

sentences.en: Is that within character?
sentences.zh: 这符合她的性格吗？

sentences.en: Is there any reason why she would have visited somebody there that was known?
sentences.zh: 有什么理由让她去那里拜访熟人吗？

sentences.en: How Sharn, or her phone, suddenly moved from Swindon 20 miles to the Savanak Forest was not the only concern.
sentences.zh: 莎诺或她的手机是如何突然从斯温登移动到20英里外的萨瓦纳克森林的，这并不是唯一的担忧。

sentences.en: If someone had taken Sharn, the statistics were grim.
sentences.zh: 如果有人带走了莎诺，统计数据非常严峻。

sentences.en: The statistics indicate that if a party is abducted with criminal intent, that they live an average of six hours, on average.
sentences.zh: 统计数据表明，如果当事人因犯罪意图被绑架，平均存活时间只有六个小时。

sentences.en: Of course, I would argue that no case is average, and every case must be taken on its merits.
sentences.zh: 当然，我会说没有哪个案件是平均的，每个案件都必须根据其具体情况来处理。

sentences.en: But the reality is that that form of criminality results in a very high proportion of cases in the murder of the abducted party.
sentences.zh: 但现实是，这种犯罪形式在绝大多数案件中都会导致被绑架者被谋杀。

sentences.en: Now, I didn't work on the assumption that she was dead.
sentences.zh: 我并没有假设她已经死了。

sentences.en: I had her abduction as one of a number of hypotheses that I was working to.
sentences.zh: 我将她的绑架作为我正在研究的多个假设之一。

sentences.en: And because of the nature of that hypothesis, and what I know about kidnap and survivability, I had to move with every resource and every ounce of energy and effort
sentences.zh: 正因为该假设的性质，以及我对绑架和生存率的了解，我必须动用我能调动的一切资源、每一分精力和努力。

sentences.en: that I could muster.
sentences.zh: 我能调动的一切。

sentences.en: If I assumed she was dead, then she would be dead.
sentences.zh: 如果我假设她已经死了，那她就真的死了。

sentences.en: Because there is no other cavalry that's coming.
sentences.zh: 因为没有其他援军会来。

sentences.en: It's me and my team or nothing.
sentences.zh: 只有我和我的团队，别无他人。

sentences.en: There is no party to pass the buck to.
sentences.zh: 没有其他人可以推卸责任。

sentences.en: Fulcher made a decision, an important decision, to immediately escalate the investigation.
sentences.zh: 富尔彻做出了一个决定，一个重要的决定，立即升级调查。

sentences.en: He designated it as a Category A, Crime in Action, the most serious category.
sentences.zh: 他将其定为 A 类“犯罪进行中”案件，这是最严重的类别。

sentences.en: It means it is a major investigation of significant concern where any member of the public is at risk, the offender is unknown, and the investigation and securing of evidence
sentences.zh: 这意味着这是一起重大的调查，涉及重大关切，公众面临风险，罪犯身份不明，且调查和证据获取

sentences.en: requires the allocation of significant resources.
sentences.zh: 需要分配大量资源。

sentences.en: Journalist Steve Brody covered the case for the BBC at the time.
sentences.zh: 记者史蒂夫·布罗迪当时为英国广播公司（BBC）报道了此案。

sentences.en: I think that the police, and certainly Detective Superintendent Steve Fulcher, knew that at the very least she'd been abducted.
sentences.zh: 我认为警方，当然还有侦探警司史蒂夫·富尔彻，知道她至少是被绑架了。

sentences.en: And I think that's why they took it seriously.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是他们认真对待的原因。

sentences.en: They took it very seriously, very early on.
sentences.zh: 他们很早就非常认真地对待了。

sentences.en: As a journalist, Brody got the sense right away that there was something different about this case.
sentences.zh: 作为一名记者，布罗迪立刻感觉到这个案子有些不同。

sentences.en: You get missing persons today.
sentences.zh: 你现在也会遇到失踪人口案件。

sentences.en: The police will put out a message saying, we're looking for so-and-so.
sentences.zh: 警方会发布消息说，我们正在寻找某某人。

sentences.en: By the afternoon, they've turned up, or even next day.
sentences.zh: 到了下午，他们就出现了，或者第二天就出现了。

sentences.en: The vast majority of the missing persons generally turn up.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数失踪人口通常都会出现。

sentences.en: And this wasn't one of those.
sentences.zh: 但这起案件并非如此。

sentences.en: I think the people got the feeling, there was a feeling that this was pretty awful and that something would have to be done.
sentences.zh: 我想人们有一种感觉，一种这事非常糟糕、必须采取行动的感觉。

sentences.en: Detective Superintendent Steve Fulcher could feel it too.
sentences.zh: 侦探警司史蒂夫·富尔彻也能感觉到。

sentences.en: A young woman who didn't come home and her phone pinging in a forest 20 miles from where she was last seen.
sentences.zh: 一个年轻女子没有回家，她的手机在离最后目击地20英里的森林里发出信号。

sentences.en: His grave concern for the welfare of Sharno Callaghan was the top priority.
sentences.zh: 他对莎诺·卡拉汉安危的深切担忧是重中之重。

sentences.en: Information that supported my concern was the fact that the family had been desperately trying to get hold of Sharno throughout the morning of Saturday the 19th.
sentences.zh: 支持我担忧的事实是，19日周六整个上午，家人一直拼命试图联系莎诺。

sentences.en: And she hadn't responded to anybody.
sentences.zh: 但她没有回复任何人。

sentences.en: That's completely out of character.
sentences.zh: 这完全不符合她的性格。

sentences.en: So her phone is in the middle of a remote rural area and she hasn't responded to her mother, to her boyfriend, or anybody.
sentences.zh: 她的手机位于偏远农村地区的中心地带，而她没有回复母亲、男友或任何人的信息。

sentences.en: So working on the hypothesis that she's been abducted from the last seen location in Swindon Old Town,
sentences.zh: 因此，基于她是在最后被目击地点——斯温登老城被绑架的假设，

sentences.en: I conducted this investigation as a crime in action.
sentences.zh: 我将此案作为一起正在进行的犯罪进行调查。

sentences.en: And what that means is that one prioritizes very clearly
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们要非常明确地优先考虑，

sentences.en: the life of the hostage or the victim in this case, Sharno Callaghan.
sentences.zh: 人质或受害者的生命，在本案中即莎诺·卡拉汉的生命。

sentences.en: Everything else is subordinate to the notion of finding Sharno, finding her as swiftly as possible and seeking to save her life.
sentences.zh: 其他一切都必须服从于找到莎诺这一目标，即尽快找到她并设法挽救她的生命。

sentences.en: I've got search teams both in the immediate vicinity of Sue Jews,
sentences.zh: 我已经在苏朱夜店附近部署了搜查小组，

sentences.en: I've got house-to-house inquiries going.
sentences.zh: 并正在进行挨家挨户的走访调查。

sentences.en: I'm looking for more CCTV evidence of where Sharno went.
sentences.zh: 我正在寻找更多关于莎诺去向的监控录像证据。

sentences.en: I've got telephony inquiries going on simultaneously because what else can telephony tell me?
sentences.zh: 我同时在进行电话通讯调查，因为电话通讯还能告诉我什么呢？

sentences.en: Simultaneously conducting inquiries with known associates, witnesses at the time, everybody that was in Sue Jews' nightclub, for instance, looking at the family cohort,
sentences.zh: 同时，我也在对已知相关人员、当时的目击者，例如苏朱夜店里的每一个人进行询问，并查看家庭成员的情况，

sentences.en: looking at any known associates and movements on that night.
sentences.zh: 调查当晚任何已知相关人员的动向。

sentences.en: And it all needs to be done fast time and simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都需要迅速且同步地完成。

sentences.en: As the Senior Investigating Officer, or SIO,
sentences.zh: 作为高级调查官（SIO），

sentences.en: Steve's decision to escalate the case to a Category A crime in action had a number of impacts on how the investigation was conducted
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫决定将案件升级为A类正在进行的犯罪，这对后续调查的开展方式产生了多方面影响，

sentences.en: further down the line, which we will explore in detail later.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会详细探讨。

sentences.en: For now, it was a huge escalation in gravity, speed and resourcing, with major knock-on impacts for his police department.
sentences.zh: 目前而言，这意味着在严重程度、速度和资源投入上的巨大升级，并对其警察部门产生了重大的连锁反应。

sentences.en: It was something he knew he would have to justify to his bosses.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己必须向老板们证明这一决定的合理性。

sentences.en: I would suggest that even if we found Sharno within a number of hours, it would have been a worthwhile response
sentences.zh: 我想说，即使我们在几个小时内就找到了莎诺，这依然是一次值得的响应，

sentences.en: because you don't know what you don't know at that given point in time.
sentences.zh: 因为在那个特定的时间点，你不知道你所不知道的事情。

sentences.en: So that was the first thing.
sentences.zh: 所以这是第一点。

sentences.en: Second thing was that in terms of categorization,
sentences.zh: 第二点是关于分类，

sentences.en: particularly after my initial lines of inquiry established that clearly the first two hypotheses were unlikely and the most likely was the most concerning of all,
sentences.zh: 特别是在我最初的调查方向确定前两个假设显然不太可能，而最可能的情况也是最令人担忧的情况之后，

sentences.en: i.e. she hasn't willingly gone to the middle of the Sabanac Forest of her own volition and therefore was most likely to have been abducted.
sentences.zh: 即她并非出于自愿前往萨巴纳克森林中心，因此极有可能是被绑架了。

sentences.en: Justified my categorizing as a Category A inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这证明了我将其归类为A类调查的合理性。

sentences.en: Now, inquiries are categorized according to the impact it would have on the rest of policing, the public and budget and finance.
sentences.zh: 调查是根据其对警务工作、公众以及预算和财务的影响进行分类的。

sentences.en: So I saw this as a crime in action that required as much resources the police force could find to as swiftly and professionally find Sharno in the shortest period of time possible.
sentences.zh: 所以我将其视为一起正在进行的犯罪，需要警方竭尽所能调动资源，以便在最短时间内专业且迅速地找到莎诺。

sentences.en: If she was found alive and well and she'd gone off with a friend, well, so be it.
sentences.zh: 如果她被发现安然无恙，只是和朋友出去了，那也无妨。

sentences.en: But actually, I had called it right, as had my colleagues in Swindon.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，我和斯温登的同事们都判断对了。

sentences.en: A great number of police forces and police responses would never have actually got into a position of dealing with this as a crime in action in the timescale in which we did.
sentences.zh: 许多警察部队和警务响应可能永远无法在我们所用的时间尺度内，将此案作为正在进行的犯罪来处理。

sentences.en: It would have been a missing person inquiry.
sentences.zh: 那可能只会是一起失踪人口调查。

sentences.en: You'd have had a 24-hour period of checking hospitals.
sentences.zh: 你可能需要花24小时去核查医院。

sentences.en: You'd have had major crime teams oftentimes claiming that they only deal with homicide, therefore they want to see a body before they take it on.
sentences.zh: 重案组通常会声称他们只处理凶杀案，因此在接手前他们想先看到尸体。

sentences.en: So your dedicated detectives around homicide wouldn't necessarily join in.
sentences.zh: 所以你专门负责凶杀案的侦探不一定会参与进来。

sentences.en: I mean, I talk in general terms, and it's certainly not generally the case, but it comes down to individual SIO decision-making.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我是在谈论一般情况，这当然不是普遍现象，但这归根结底取决于高级调查官个人的决策。

sentences.en: What are we going to do here?
sentences.zh: 我们在这里要做什么？

sentences.en: How much resource are we going to put in?
sentences.zh: 我们要投入多少资源？

sentences.en: How much effort are we going to instigate to ensure that we prioritize the most important thing?
sentences.zh: 我们要采取多大的努力来确保我们优先处理最重要的事情？

sentences.en: I mean, instinct is honed over many, many years of experience, usually bitter experience of cases that one has dealt with.
sentences.zh: 直觉通常是经过多年经验磨练出来的，通常是处理案件时留下的痛苦经验。

sentences.en: So I'd been a police officer for 28 years, dealt with many crimes in action, kidnap, and homicides.
sentences.zh: 我当了28年的警察，处理过许多正在进行的犯罪、绑架和凶杀案。

sentences.en: And of course, a whole raft of other offenses as well.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有其他各种各样的犯罪。

sentences.en: I was a professional detective.
sentences.zh: 我是一名职业侦探。

sentences.en: That's what I did for a living.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的职业。

sentences.en: From the accounts of the girls that she was with that evening, they'd left her in Suju.
sentences.zh: 根据当晚与她在一起的女孩们的陈述，她们把她留在了苏朱夜店。

sentences.en: So we knew that we wanted to get the footage from Suju's nightclub, which we gathered.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道我们需要获取苏朱夜店的监控录像，我们也确实拿到了。

sentences.en: We could see that she was shown on the cameras in the backyard of that premises, socializing with people.
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到她在该场所后院的摄像头中出现，与人社交。

sentences.en: So of course, the question is asked, who are those people?
sentences.zh: 所以当然会有人问，那些人是谁？

sentences.en: Do they have any involvement in her disappearance?
sentences.zh: 他们与她的失踪有关吗？

sentences.en: By late Saturday night, Fulcher was still no closer to locating Sian, and the investigation continued into Sunday morning, by which point Sian had been missing for over 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 到了周六深夜，富尔彻在定位莎恩方面仍无进展，调查持续到周日早上，此时莎恩已经失踪超过24小时了。

sentences.en: It was time for Fulcher to retrace the steps of the missing woman, and also her abductor.
sentences.zh: 是时候让富尔彻重走一遍这位失踪女性以及她绑架者的路线了。

sentences.en: On Sunday morning, I went to Old Town, to Suju's nightclub, retraced the steps.
sentences.zh: 周日早上，我去了老城，去了苏朱夜店，重走了那条路线。

sentences.en: And this is all about trying to put yourself back into the position, both of Sian and potentially of Sian's abductor.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为了让自己回到莎恩，以及潜在的莎恩绑架者的位置上。

sentences.en: What's happened here?
sentences.zh: 这里发生了什么？

sentences.en: What can I sense?
sentences.zh: 我能感觉到什么？

sentences.en: What can I see?
sentences.zh: 我能看到什么？

sentences.en: What's out of place?
sentences.zh: 有什么不对劲的地方？

sentences.en: Where could she have gone?
sentences.zh: 她可能去了哪里？

sentences.en: I mean, simple things like the layout of that Old Town.
sentences.zh: 我是说，一些简单的事情，比如老城的布局。

sentences.en: There's derelict buildings.
sentences.zh: 那里有废弃的建筑物。

sentences.en: There's recreation grounds.
sentences.zh: 有娱乐场所。

sentences.en: There's whole rafts of places that could potentially be searched for Sian.
sentences.zh: 有大片可能需要搜寻莎恩的地方。

sentences.en: She could have been dragged off into bushes in this location.
sentences.zh: 她可能在这个位置被拖进了灌木丛。

sentences.en: We'd better put a search team in there, and so on.
sentences.zh: 我们最好派一个搜查队去那里，诸如此类。

sentences.en: So getting a feeling for the size of the task, in terms of searching for Sian physically, but also putting yourself back into the mindset of both Sian and the other party to this,
sentences.zh: 所以要对任务的规模有一个感觉，不仅是在物理上搜寻莎恩，还要让自己回到莎恩和此案另一方的思维模式中，

sentences.en: if she has been abducted.
sentences.zh: 如果她确实被绑架了的话。

sentences.en: How did he pick her out?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么选中她的？

sentences.en: What would he have seen?
sentences.zh: 他会看到什么？

sentences.en: What would his mode of approach be?
sentences.zh: 他的接近方式会是什么？

sentences.en: So those kind of things are standard, but useful.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是常规但有用的思考。

sentences.en: When an examination of CCTV footage showed Sian only at the nightclub and gave no clues to her whereabouts, it was time for Steve Vulture to follow Sian's phone into the foreSt.
sentences.zh: 当对监控录像的检查显示莎恩只出现在夜店，且没有提供她下落的线索时，史蒂夫·富尔彻是时候跟随莎恩的手机进入森林了。

sentences.en: I had no knowledge of where she'd gone.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她去了哪里。

sentences.en: The last sighting was on that CCTV footage at Suju's.
sentences.zh: 最后一次目击是在苏朱夜店的监控录像中。

sentences.en: So obviously, it was a search parameter within the immediate environs of Swindon Old Town in the vicinity of Suju's.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，搜寻范围是在斯温登老城苏朱夜店附近的周边地区。

sentences.en: But I knew that her phone, at least, is somewhere in the Sabanak ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 但我知道她的手机至少在萨巴纳克森林的某个地方。

sentences.en: Now, it's a six and a half kilometer radius area, which is huge.
sentences.zh: 那是一个半径六点五公里的区域，非常巨大。

sentences.en: And the first thing I did was get traffic officers to do the drive.
sentences.zh: 我做的第一件事就是让交通警察开车走一遍。

sentences.en: How long would it take physically to get between those two points and send the helicopter up on that evening with heat-seeking equipment
sentences.zh: 在两个点之间实际需要多长时间，并当晚派出带有热成像设备的直升机，

sentences.en: to see whether they could find any traces with a flyover?
sentences.zh: 看看他们能否通过飞越发现任何痕迹？

sentences.en: The Sabanak Forest is the stuff of fairy tales.
sentences.zh: 萨巴纳克森林就像童话故事里的场景。

sentences.en: Giant oaks with names like Big Belly and Sleeping Dragon twist themselves into agonized shapes.
sentences.zh: 巨大的橡树有着像“大肚”和“睡龙”这样的名字，扭曲成痛苦的形状。

sentences.en: In winter, they are dark and bare, covered in snow.
sentences.zh: 冬天，它们黑暗而光秃，覆盖着积雪。

sentences.en: In autumn, they shine like gold.
sentences.zh: 秋天，它们闪耀如金。

sentences.en: On Sunday the 20th of March 2011, the early morning fog cast a pall over the foreSt.
sentences.zh: 2011年3月20日周日，清晨的浓雾笼罩着森林。

sentences.en: There was a chill in the air and the temperature hovered around 8 degrees Celsius for most of the day.
sentences.zh: 空气中透着寒意，全天气温大多徘徊在8摄氏度左右。

sentences.en: It was here that the electronic tracking systems that operate between phones and towers sent the police.
sentences.zh: 正是电子追踪系统在手机和信号塔之间运作，将警察引向了这里。

sentences.en: The mobile telephony system works on the basis of signals being passed between fixed points, masts which relay the signal.
sentences.zh: 移动电话系统的工作原理是信号在固定点之间传递，即中继信号的基站。

sentences.en: And you can get a reading off the relevant mast that the signals bounced off.
sentences.zh: 你可以从信号反射的相关基站读取数据。

sentences.en: So we can be definitively clear that her phone, at least, was in Swindon Old Town at 10 to 3, but her phone, at least, was in the middle of Sabanak Forest half an hour later.
sentences.zh: 所以我们可以确定，她的手机至少在2点50分时还在斯温登老城，但半小时后，她的手机至少已经在萨巴纳克森林中心了。

sentences.en: The difficulty with the Sabanak Forest is that because it's such a rural, remote location, there's only one maSt.
sentences.zh: 萨巴纳克森林的困难在于，因为它是一个如此偏远、荒凉的地方，只有一个基站。

sentences.en: And what we would generally do is triangulate the signals to get a closer geographic fix on where the phone or the individual is.
sentences.zh: 我们通常会通过三角测量信号来更精确地定位手机或个人的地理位置。

sentences.en: With only one mast in Sabanak Forest, that wasn't possible.
sentences.zh: 由于萨巴纳克森林只有一个基站，这在当时是不可能的。

sentences.en: So, of course, it left a huge potential search area of six and a half kilometre radius within which Sian, or at least her phone, had to be.
sentences.zh: 所以，这留下了一个巨大的潜在搜寻区域，即半径六点五公里的范围，莎恩或至少她的手机必须在其中。

sentences.en: But clearly, the priority, or all I knew at that stage, was that her phone, at least, is in that Sabanak Forest somewhere.
sentences.zh: 但显然，优先事项，或者我在那个阶段所知道的一切，就是她的手机至少在萨巴纳克森林的某个地方。

sentences.en: And that's got to be searched.
sentences.zh: 必须对那里进行搜查。

sentences.en: We've got to try and find them.
sentences.zh: 我们必须设法找到他们。

sentences.en: We've got to do it urgently.
sentences.zh: 我们必须紧急行动。

sentences.en: You know, a significant proportion of resource was put into that because you're talking about a colossal area if you're going to do a formal line search.
sentences.zh: 你知道，投入了相当大比例的资源，因为如果你要进行正式的排线搜查，那是一个巨大的区域。

sentences.en: A line search is a police technique where you, as it suggests, walk in a line, but you're within arm's breadth of each other.
sentences.zh: 排线搜查是一种警察技术，顾名思义，就是排成一排走，但彼此之间保持手臂的距离。

sentences.en: So you can imagine what resource commitment that would require if you were going to do that.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象，如果你要那样做，需要投入多少资源。

sentences.en: Obviously, the helicopter is useful in terms of heat-seeking.
sentences.zh: 显然，直升机在热成像方面很有用。

sentences.en: Dogs as well.
sentences.zh: 还有警犬。

sentences.en: So we sent the dogs out to see whether they could get a trace.
sentences.zh: 所以我们派出了警犬，看看它们能否追踪到痕迹。

sentences.en: One of the many early strategies in the investigation was to try and utilise both traditional media and social media opportunities in order to support the investigation.
sentences.zh: 调查早期的众多策略之一是尝试利用传统媒体和社交媒体的机会，以支持调查。

sentences.en: If they could inform the public, perhaps that could lead to a crucial witness coming forward.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能通知公众，也许能引导关键证人站出来。

sentences.en: But something unexpected happened.
sentences.zh: 但发生了一些意想不到的事情。

sentences.en: BBC journalist Steve Brody explains how the public were quick to respond to the story of the missing young woman.
sentences.zh: BBC记者史蒂夫·布罗迪解释了公众是如何迅速响应这位失踪年轻女性的故事的。

sentences.en: I think it may have been on the Sunday or the Monday when the public began to get aware of this.
sentences.zh: 我想可能是在周日或周一，公众开始意识到这件事。

sentences.en: And I have to say, there was instant rapport between the public and the police and indeed the media.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，公众与警方，甚至媒体之间产生了即时的共鸣。

sentences.en: It became one of those stories.
sentences.zh: 它成了那种广为流传的故事之一。

sentences.en: You will never know why a story gets to the heart of the public.
sentences.zh: 你永远不会知道为什么一个故事能触动公众的心弦。

sentences.en: There's no great thing about it.
sentences.zh: 这并没有什么了不起的原因。

sentences.en: Why does it happen?
sentences.zh: 为什么会发生这种情况？

sentences.en: Why doesn't it happen?
sentences.zh: 为什么又不会发生？

sentences.en: This was one of those stories where people wanted to find this young girl.
sentences.zh: 这是那种人们想要找到这个年轻女孩的故事之一。

sentences.en: The huge public response took Steve Fulcher by surprise as well.
sentences.zh: 巨大的公众反应也让史蒂夫·富尔彻感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Thousands of people converged on the forest to look for Sian.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人涌向森林寻找莎恩。

sentences.en: I mean, it was the most extraordinary reaction.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是最非凡的反应。

sentences.en: Even if I'd wanted to set a different press strategy, I couldn't because social media was alive to the fact that Sian had gone missing amongst her friends and family.
sentences.zh: 即使我想制定不同的新闻策略，我也做不到，因为社交媒体上关于莎恩在朋友和家人中失踪的消息已经传开了。

sentences.en: People were turning up in Savanak Forest to physically search for her in the hope that she was recoverable,
sentences.zh: 人们出现在萨巴纳克森林，希望能找到她，希望能救回她，

sentences.en: that she'd perhaps been left somewhere and was injured and could be saved.
sentences.zh: 也许她被留在了某个地方，受了伤，还能被救活。

sentences.en: So it's one of the most extraordinary things I've ever come across, actually, in which by the Sunday and certainly the Monday, over 10,000 people from Swindon, voluntarily,
sentences.zh: 所以这是我见过的最非凡的事情之一，实际上，到了周日，当然还有周一，超过10000名斯温登市民，自愿地，

sentences.en: unasked for by me, unbidden, had given up their time, their work, their weekend to look for Sian O'Gallan.
sentences.zh: 在我没有要求，没有号召的情况下，放弃了他们的时间、工作和周末，去寻找莎恩·奥卡拉汉。

sentences.en: Steve Brody watched the response from the newsroom.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·布罗迪在新闻编辑室观察着这一反应。

sentences.en: And it was quite extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 这真是太非凡了。

sentences.en: I was in the newsroom in Bristol and I saw these pictures come in of hundreds of people turned up.
sentences.zh: 我在布里斯托尔的新闻编辑室，我看到这些照片传进来，成百上千的人出现了。

sentences.en: Not scores, hundreds of people turned up, all passionately wanting to help the police find Sian.
sentences.zh: 不是几十人，是数百人出现了，所有人都充满激情地想要帮助警方找到莎恩。

sentences.en: An unprecedented public response.
sentences.zh: 前所未有的公众响应。

sentences.en: In fact, there were so many members of the public turned up that the police didn't have enough officers to direct them properly.
sentences.zh: 事实上，出现的公众人数太多，以至于警方没有足够的警力来妥善引导他们。

sentences.en: Sian's brother, Liam, was awed by the community response for his missing sister.
sentences.zh: 莎恩的哥哥利亚姆对社区为他失踪的妹妹所做的反应感到敬畏。

sentences.en: Not only did it help his family to know there were so many people searching for Sian, but it allowed them to stay at home together and wait for news,
sentences.zh: 这不仅帮助他的家人知道有这么多人正在寻找莎恩，而且让他们能够待在家里一起等待消息，

sentences.en: as advised by their family liaison officer, FLO for short.
sentences.zh: 正如他们的家庭联络官（简称FLO）所建议的那样。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was very surprised that they'd taken her back and also proud as well, you know, to think that the community sort of rallied like that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很惊讶他们把她带回来了，也感到很自豪，你知道，想到社区能这样团结起来。

sentences.en: I remember, yeah,
sentences.zh: 我记得，是的，

sentences.en: sort of seeing on the media coaches turning up and people actually getting into coaches and actually going to Savanak in hoards and obviously going out searching and watching the police sort of coordinate it as well.
sentences.zh: 在媒体上看到大巴车开过来，人们真的上了大巴，成群结队地前往萨巴纳克，显然是出去搜寻，也看着警察在协调这一切。

sentences.en: Being very impressed that you're, you know, living around people that are prepared to do that.
sentences.zh: 对你生活在周围的人愿意这样做感到印象深刻。

sentences.en: Being an older brother, you kind of want to get involved.
sentences.zh: 作为一个哥哥，你很想参与其中。

sentences.en: You kind of want to get involved in the searches.
sentences.zh: 你很想参与到搜寻中去。

sentences.en: And I had people around me sort of saying that maybe it's best we just sort of stay in our kind of bubble that we had formed in the house and that it wasn't a good idea to be going out.
sentences.zh: 我周围的人说，也许我们最好待在家里形成的那个小圈子里，出去并不是个好主意。

sentences.en: And actually, I think it was one of the family liaison officers actually advised that it probably wasn't the best use of my time.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我想是一位家庭联络官建议说，这可能不是我时间的最佳利用方式。

sentences.en: But then to see, obviously,
sentences.zh: 但后来看到，显然，

sentences.en: on the media that there was all these people in Swindon actually going out actively trying to find Sharp sort of relaxed my own sort of need to want to go out and hand out posters and sort of try and find Sharp.
sentences.zh: 在媒体上看到斯温登有这么多人主动出去寻找莎恩，这缓解了我自己想要出去分发海报并试图寻找莎恩的冲动。

sentences.en: And once the public became involved in droves, it spurred the police to go to even greater lengths.
sentences.zh: 一旦公众大量参与进来，这就促使警方付出了更大的努力。

sentences.en: Steve Fulcher explains this flow-on effect.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·富尔彻解释了这种连锁反应。

sentences.en: What was striking about this entire inquiry, the professionalism of the police force, not just Wiltshire Police, but in surrounding forces as well, officers were,
sentences.zh: 整个调查中最引人注目的是警察部队的专业精神，不仅是威尔特郡警方，周边地区的警力也是如此，警官们，

sentences.en: I couldn't send them off duty.
sentences.zh: 我无法让他们下班。

sentences.en: They would not leave duty because they were so committed to this notion of finding Sian.
sentences.zh: 他们不愿离开岗位，因为他们对找到莎恩这一目标如此执着。

sentences.en: You know, my role was to ensure that we had the right hypotheses and the right resources and the right sense of direction so everybody had a proper role to perform.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的职责是确保我们有正确的假设、正确的资源和正确的方向感，这样每个人都有一个合适的角色可以发挥。

sentences.en: You can see how many things you need to do simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到你需要同时处理多少事情。

sentences.en: I always talk about 24 simultaneous strands, that if you drop one of them, you'll be criticized later or the inquiry will fail.
sentences.zh: 我常说有24条线索需要同时跟进，如果丢掉其中任何一条，事后就会受到指责，或者调查就会失败。

sentences.en: So, of course, I want intelligence experts there.
sentences.zh: 所以，我当然希望情报专家能在场。

sentences.en: I want forensic experts there.
sentences.zh: 我希望法医专家能在场。

sentences.en: I want telephony experts.
sentences.zh: 我希望电话通讯专家能在场。

sentences.en: And these guys come round in one concerted effort.
sentences.zh: 这些人齐心协力，共同行动。

sentences.en: It is the moment in policing which is most gratifying when you've got such a professional team working to a clear direction so effectively.
sentences.zh: 当拥有一支如此专业的团队，朝着明确的方向高效工作时，这是警务工作中令人最欣慰的时刻。

sentences.en: And what we did, what we did in this short period of time is probably, I'm not going to say it's unprecedented because I'm sure there's lots of other good examples.
sentences.zh: 我们所做的，我们在这么短的时间内所做的，我不会说它是史无前例的，因为我相信还有很多其他优秀的例子。

sentences.en: But what we did was extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 但我们所做的一切是非凡的。

sentences.en: And all dedicated to this one end, we will find Sian.
sentences.zh: 大家的目标只有一个，那就是找到西安。

sentences.en: On the next episode of The Detective's Dilemma.
sentences.zh: 在下一集《侦探的困境》中。

sentences.en: I just want to say how very worried we are about Sian.
sentences.zh: 我只想说我们有多么担心西安。

sentences.en: The footage from the CCTV camera was quite a breakthrough on that Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 周一早上，监控摄像头的录像是一个相当大的突破。

sentences.en: It's blatantly obvious that she got in that car.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，她上了那辆车。

sentences.en: Whoever had taken her had done it for criminal purposes.
sentences.zh: 无论带走她的人是谁，其目的都是犯罪。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: If you'd like to hear the rest of The Detective's Dilemma, you can find it wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 如果您想收听《侦探的困境》的后续内容，您可以在任何获取播客的地方找到它。
